beats.headline: The Book of the Floor Club
beats.text: Donut leaps onto the safe room's mailbox and its front opens on its own. A tome floats out. A boss box has made her a member of the Dungeon Book of the Floor Club: one spellbook per level, mailed to her. She reads it at once, and says ew. Carl reminds her, again, to read the description first. It's Second Chance, ten mana: she can raise a lower-level monster from the dead to fight for them for as many minutes as the spell's level. It's disgusting, she says, until Carl suggests raising a dead dingo to kill another dingo, like the Lucia Mar kid with her two dogs. This is the best spell ever.

beats.headline: Undead minion, level one
beats.text: Donut has headshot three clurichauns and has fourteen mana left, so Carl asks if she wants to try her new Second Chance spell. Her whole body glows neon purple. One of the dead clurichauns twitches, glows to match and stumbles to its feet, its scorched head listing, a one-minute timer over it: Undead Minion of Crawler Princess Donut. Donut finds it most unpleasant and has no sort of controls, but told to rip up the bodies of its friends, it does, and within seconds it is dead again, the job unfinished. For the next hour she raises one after every skirmish so Carl can practise his slingshot on it, and the spell reaches level three: the minions now last three minutes.
